2026_02_WAS_DAL.headline: Washington’s missing middle pieces raise the stakes for an early NFC East response in Dallas
2026_02_WAS_DAL.paragraph1: Washington enters Dallas without linebacker Frankie Luvu and tight end Chig Okonkwo, removing an important communicator on defense and a useful piece from the offensive formation mix. Both teams are trying to avoid an 0-2 divisional hole after opening losses. The Commanders need faster early-down execution and replacement defenders to limit explosive gains; Dallas needs Dak Prescott’s offense to sustain drives and prevent Washington’s pass rush from controlling obvious passing situations.
2026_02_WAS_DAL.model_rationale: Washington’s replacement production in the middle of both units and Dallas’ ability to keep Prescott out of predictable passing downs are the clearest drivers of sustained offense.
